AFG.title: Hindu Kush
AFG.body: Afghanistan is a mountainous country of the Hindu Kush. The medieval Minaret of Jam still stands in a remote valley.
AFG.local: افغانستان کشور کوه‌های هندوکش است و منار جام، برج کهنه‌ای در یک دره دور، هنوز پابرجاست.

ALB.title: Its own language
ALB.body: Albanian is its own branch of the Indo-European language family, unlike its neighbors’ tongues. The Ionian coast is lined with steep stone towns.
ALB.local: Shqipja është një degë më vete e familjes indoevropiane. Bregu i Jonit është plot qyteza guri.

DZA.title: Largest in Africa
DZA.body: Algeria is the largest country in Africa. Most of it is Sahara, and the old city of Algiers climbs a hillside above the Mediterranean.
DZA.local: الجزائر أكبر بلد في أفريقيا. معظمها صحراء، ومدينة الجزائر العتيقة تصعد فوق البحر المتوسط.

AGO.title: Giant sable
AGO.body: Angola is a major oil producer and the only home of the giant sable antelope, a rare animal with long curved horns.
AGO.local: Angola é um grande produtor de petróleo e o único lar da palanca-negra-gigante, um antílope raro de chifres longos.

ARG.title: Tango and the south
ARG.body: Tango was born in Buenos Aires. Argentina reaches far south toward Tierra del Fuego, where the Andes meet the Atlantic.
ARG.local: El tango nació en Buenos Aires. Argentina llega muy al sur, hasta Tierra del Fuego, donde los Andes se encuentran con el Atlántico.

ARM.title: First Christian state
ARM.body: In the year 301, Armenia became the first state to adopt Christianity as its official religion.
ARM.local: 301 թվականին Հայաստանը դարձավ առաջին պետությունը, որ քրիստոնեությունը հռչակեց պաշտոնական կրոն։

AUS.title: Country and continent
AUS.body: Australia is the only country that is also its own continent. Kangaroos and platypuses live almost nowhere else.
AUS.local: Australia is the only country that is also its own continent. Kangaroos and platypuses live almost nowhere else.

AUT.title: Alps and music
AUT.body: Austria’s Alps are famous for skiing, and Vienna was home to Mozart and many other composers.
AUT.local: Österreichs Alpen sind berühmt zum Skifahren, und Wien war die Heimat von Mozart und vielen anderen Komponisten.

AZE.title: Land of fire
AZE.body: Azerbaijan is called the Land of Fire because natural gas seeps have burned for centuries, including the hillside flames of Yanar Dag.
AZE.local: Azərbaycan Odlar Yurdu adlanır, çünki təbii qaz sızmaları əsrlərdir yanır, o cümlədən Yanar Dağın alovları.

BHS.title: Shallow seas
BHS.body: The Bahamas is made of hundreds of islands and cays sitting in some of the clearest shallow water in the Atlantic.
BHS.local: The Bahamas is made of hundreds of islands and cays sitting in some of the clearest shallow water in the Atlantic.

BGD.title: The great delta
BGD.body: Bangladesh holds the world’s largest river delta, where the Ganges and Brahmaputra spread out to meet the sea.
BGD.local: বাংলাদেশে বিশ্বের সবচেয়ে বড় নদীবদ্বীপ আছে, যেখানে গঙ্গা ও ব্রহ্মপুত্র সমুদ্রে মেশে।

BLR.title: Ancient forest
BLR.body: Belarus shares the Białowieża Forest with Poland, one of the last old-growth forests in Europe and a home of the European bison.
BLR.local: Беларусь делит с Польшей Беловежскую пущу — один из последних старых лесов Европы и дом европейского зубра.

BEL.title: Saxophone country
BEL.body: The saxophone was invented in Belgium by Adolphe Sax. The country is also famous for chocolate and waffles.
BEL.local: De saxofoon werd in België uitgevonden door Adolphe Sax. Het land is ook beroemd om chocolade en wafels.

BLZ.title: The reef
BLZ.body: Belize’s barrier reef is part of the second-largest reef system in the world, and Maya cities such as Caracol stand inland.
BLZ.local: Belize’s barrier reef is part of the second-largest reef system in the world, and Maya cities such as Caracol stand inland.

BEN.title: Kingdom of Dahomey
BEN.body: Benin was the heart of the Kingdom of Dahomey and is a historic center of Vodun.
BEN.local: Le Bénin était le cœur du royaume du Dahomey et un centre historique du vodoun.

BTN.title: Gross national happiness
BTN.body: Bhutan measures progress with Gross National Happiness as well as money, and it limits tourism to protect its mountain valleys.

BOL.title: Mirror of salt
BOL.body: Salar de Uyuni, in Bolivia, is the largest salt flat on Earth. In the rainy season it turns into a giant mirror.
BOL.local: El salar de Uyuni, en Bolivia, es el salar más grande de la Tierra. En la época de lluvias se vuelve un espejo gigante.

BIH.title: The old bridge
BIH.body: The stone bridge of Mostar, Stari Most, was built by the Ottomans in the 1500s and still spans the Neretva River.
BIH.local: Stari most u Mostaru sagradili su Osmanlije u 16. stoljeću i još uvijek premošćuje Neretvu.

BWA.title: Inland delta
BWA.body: Botswana has the Okavango Delta, a huge inland delta in the Kalahari, and some of Africa’s largest elephant herds.
BWA.local: Botswana has the Okavango Delta, a huge inland delta in the Kalahari, and some of Africa’s largest elephant herds.

BRA.title: Amazon and five cups
BRA.body: Brazil holds most of the Amazon, the largest rainforest on Earth. It has also won the men’s football World Cup five times, more than any other country.
BRA.local: O Brasil guarda a maior parte da Amazônia, a maior floresta tropical da Terra. Também venceu a Copa do Mundo masculina cinco vezes, mais do que qualquer outro país.

BRN.title: Water village
BRN.body: Brunei’s capital has Kampong Ayer, one of the largest water villages, where houses stand on stilts over the river.
BRN.local: Ibu negara Brunei mempunyai Kampong Ayer, salah satu kampung air terbesar, dengan rumah di atas tonggak sungai.

BGR.title: Valley of roses
BGR.body: Bulgaria’s Valley of Roses grows flowers used to make much of the world’s rose oil for perfume.
BGR.local: Долината на розите в България отглежда цветя, от които се прави голяма част от розовото масло за парфюми.

BFA.title: Land of honest people
BFA.body: Burkina Faso’s name means “land of honest people.” The country is known for wooden masks and a strong film tradition.
BFA.local: Le nom Burkina Faso signifie « pays des hommes intègres ». Le pays est connu pour ses masques en bois et son cinéma.

BDI.title: Royal drums
BDI.body: Burundi is famous for its royal drumming. Lake Tanganyika, one of the world’s deepest lakes, forms much of its border.
BDI.local: Le Burundi est célèbre pour ses tambours royaux. Le lac Tanganyika, l’un des plus profonds du monde, forme une grande partie de sa frontière.

KHM.title: Angkor Wat
KHM.body: Angkor Wat, in Cambodia, is the largest religious monument on Earth, built in the 1100s.
KHM.local: ប្រាសាទអង្គរវត្តនៅកម្ពុជា គឺជាបូជនីយដ្ឋានសាសនាធំជាងគេលើផែនដី សាងនៅសតវត្សទី១២។

CMR.title: Africa in miniature
CMR.body: Cameroon is often called Africa in miniature because it has coast, rainforest, savanna, and high mountains in one country.
CMR.local: Le Cameroun est souvent appelé l’Afrique en miniature : côte, forêt, savane et hautes montagnes dans un seul pays.

CAN.title: Longest coast
CAN.body: Canada has the longest coastline of any country, touching the Atlantic, the Pacific, and the Arctic.
CAN.local: Canada has the longest coastline of any country, touching the Atlantic, the Pacific, and the Arctic.

CAF.title: Forest elephants
CAF.body: The Dzanga-Sangha reserve in the Central African Republic is famous for forest elephants that gather in a forest clearing.
CAF.local: La réserve de Dzanga-Sangha, en République centrafricaine, est célèbre pour les éléphants de forêt qui se rassemblent dans une clairière.

TCD.title: Lake country
TCD.body: Chad takes its name from Lake Chad. The lake, though smaller than it once was, has long been a crossroads of the Sahel.
TCD.local: Le Tchad tire son nom du lac Tchad. Ce lac, plus petit qu’autrefois, est depuis longtemps un carrefour du Sahel.

CHL.title: A long country
CHL.body: Chile is a very long, narrow country. The Atacama Desert in the north is the driest non-polar desert on Earth.
CHL.local: Chile es un país muy largo y estrecho. El desierto de Atacama, al norte, es el desierto no polar más seco de la Tierra.

CHN.title: The long wall
CHN.body: The Great Wall of China is the longest wall ever built. Wild giant pandas live only in China’s mountain forests.
CHN.local: 中国的长城是人类建造过的最长城墙。野生大熊猫只生活在中国的山林里。

COL.title: Two oceans
COL.body: Colombia is the only country in South America with a coast on both the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea.
COL.local: Colombia es el único país de América del Sur con costa en el Pacífico y en el Caribe.

COG.title: Congo rainforest
COG.body: The Republic of the Congo shares the Congo rainforest and the Congo River, the deepest river in the world.
COG.local: La république du Congo partage la forêt du Congo et le fleuve Congo, le plus profond du monde.

COD.title: Deepest river
COD.body: The Congo River, in DR Congo, is the deepest river on Earth. The rainforest around it is the second largest after the Amazon.
COD.local: Le fleuve Congo, en RD Congo, est le plus profond de la Terre. La forêt autour est la deuxième plus grande après l’Amazonie.

CRI.title: No army
CRI.body: Costa Rica abolished its army in 1948 and spent the money on schools and clinics. It is one of the few countries with no standing military.
CRI.local: Costa Rica abolió su ejército en 1948 y usó el dinero en escuelas y clínicas. Es uno de los pocos países sin ejército permanente.

HRV.title: A thousand islands
HRV.body: Croatia’s coast has more than a thousand islands. The stone walls of Dubrovnik are a medieval city by the sea.
HRV.local: Hrvatska obala ima više od tisuću otoka. Zidine Dubrovnika su srednjovjekovni grad uz more.

CUB.title: Largest Caribbean island
CUB.body: Cuba is the largest island in the Caribbean. Son music began there, and Havana is known for its old American cars.
CUB.local: Cuba es la isla más grande del Caribe. Allí nació el son, y La Habana es famosa por sus autos americanos antiguos.

CYP.title: Aphrodite’s shore
CYP.body: Cyprus is, in Greek myth, the birthplace of Aphrodite. Petra tou Romiou on the south coast is the rock named for that story.
CYP.local: Η Κύπρος είναι, στον ελληνικό μύθο, η γενέτειρα της Αφροδίτης. Η Πέτρα του Ρωμιού στη νότια ακτή συνδέεται με αυτή την ιστορία.

CZE.title: The Orloj
CZE.body: Prague’s astronomical clock, the Orloj, was built in the Middle Ages and still tells the time and the calendar.
CZE.local: Pražský orloj byl postaven ve středověku a stále ukazuje čas i kalendář.

DNK.title: Home of Lego
DNK.body: Lego was invented in Billund, Denmark, in the 1940s and 1950s. Denmark is also a kingdom of hundreds of islands.
DNK.local: Lego blev opfundet i Billund i Danmark i 1940’erne og 1950’erne. Danmark er også et kongerige med hundredvis af øer.

DJI.title: Gate of the seas
DJI.body: Djibouti sits on the Bab el-Mandeb strait, a narrow sea gate between the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean. Lake Assal is one of the saltiest lakes.
DJI.local: تقع جيبوتي على مضيق باب المندب، بوابة ضيقة بين البحر الأحمر والمحيط الهندي. وبحيرة عسل من أشد البحيرات ملوحة.

DOM.title: Highest in the Caribbean
DOM.body: The Dominican Republic shares the island of Hispaniola. Pico Duarte, its highest peak, is the tallest mountain in the Caribbean.
DOM.local: La República Dominicana comparte la isla de La Española. El pico Duarte es la montaña más alta del Caribe.

ECU.title: Named for the equator
ECU.body: Ecuador is named for the equator, which crosses the country. The summit of Chimborazo is the point on Earth’s surface farthest from the planet’s center.
ECU.local: Ecuador debe su nombre al ecuador, que cruza el país. La cima del Chimborazo es el punto de la superficie terrestre más alejado del centro del planeta.

EGY.title: Pyramids and the Nile
EGY.body: The Great Pyramid at Giza was the tallest building on Earth for about 3,800 years. The Nile runs the length of Egypt.
EGY.local: كان الهرم الأكبر في الجيزة أطول مبنى على الأرض لنحو ٣٨٠٠ سنة. ويمتد النيل على طول مصر.

SLV.title: Volcano country
SLV.body: El Salvador is the smallest country in Central America and is dotted with volcanoes, including Izalco, once called the Lighthouse of the Pacific.
SLV.local: El Salvador es el país más pequeño de América Central y está lleno de volcanes, entre ellos el Izalco.

GNQ.title: On the equator
GNQ.body: Equatorial Guinea is named for the equator, which passes through it, and it includes both mainland rainforest and the island of Bioko.
GNQ.local: Guinea Ecuatorial debe su nombre al ecuador, que la atraviesa, e incluye selva continental y la isla de Bioko.

ERI.title: Red Sea modernism
ERI.body: Eritrea has a long Red Sea coast. Its capital, Asmara, is known for a remarkable set of modernist buildings from the 1930s.
ERI.local: ኤርትራ ነዊሕ ገምጋም ቀይሕ ባሕሪ ኣለዋ። ርእሰ ከተማኣ ኣስመራ ብናይ 1930ታት ዘመናዊ ህንጻታት ትፍለጥ።

EST.title: Digital first
EST.body: Estonia runs much of daily life online, from taxes to voting. It also has thousands of islands in the Baltic Sea.
EST.local: Eestis käib suur osa igapäevaelust internetis, maksudest hääletamiseni. Läänemeres on tal ka tuhandeid saari.

SWZ.title: Ceremonies of a kingdom
SWZ.body: Eswatini is one of the world’s last absolute monarchies. The Incwala and Reed Dance are its best-known ceremonies.
SWZ.local: Eswatini is one of the world’s last absolute monarchies. The Incwala and Reed Dance are its best-known ceremonies.

ETH.title: Home of coffee
ETH.body: Coffee was first found in Ethiopia. The country also keeps its own calendar, about seven years behind the one most of the world uses.
ETH.local: ቡና መጀመሪያ የተገኘው በኢትዮጵያ ነው። ሀገሪቱም የራሷን አቆጣጠር ትጠቀማለች፣ ከብዙዎቹ ሀገራት አቆጣጠር ወደ ሰባት ዓመት የሚያንስ።

FLK.title: Penguin islands
FLK.body: The Falkland Islands are home to huge colonies of penguins, including king penguins and rockhoppers.
FLK.local: The Falkland Islands are home to huge colonies of penguins, including king penguins and rockhoppers.

FJI.title: First light
FJI.body: Fiji sits just west of the international date line, so it is among the first countries to begin each new day.
FJI.local: Fiji sits just west of the international date line, so it is among the first countries to begin each new day.

FIN.title: Sauna country
FIN.body: Finland has about three million saunas, roughly one for every two people, one of the highest sauna counts anywhere.
FIN.local: Suomessa on noin kolme miljoonaa saunaa, suunnilleen yksi kahta ihmistä kohti.

FRA.title: Most visited
FRA.body: France welcomes more international visitors than any other country. The Eiffel Tower was the world’s tallest structure when it opened in 1889.
FRA.local: La France accueille plus de visiteurs étrangers que tout autre pays. La tour Eiffel était la plus haute structure du monde à son ouverture en 1889.

GAB.title: Beach elephants
GAB.body: Gabon is one of the most forested countries on Earth. At Loango, forest elephants sometimes walk on the Atlantic beach.
GAB.local: Le Gabon est l’un des pays les plus boisés de la Terre. À Loango, des éléphants de forêt marchent parfois sur la plage de l’Atlantique.

GMB.title: A river country
GMB.body: The Gambia is a thin country wrapped around the Gambia River and is known for huge numbers of birds.
GMB.local: The Gambia is a thin country wrapped around the Gambia River and is known for huge numbers of birds.

GEO.title: Birthplace of wine
GEO.body: People in Georgia have made wine for about 8,000 years, often in buried clay jars called qvevri.
GEO.local: საქართველოში ღვინოს დაახლოებით 8 000 წელია აყენებენ, ხშირად მიწაში ჩაფლულ ქვევრებში.

DEU.title: Nine neighbors
DEU.body: Germany shares a land border with nine countries. The fairy-tale castle of Neuschwanstein stands in the Bavarian Alps.
DEU.local: Deutschland grenzt an neun Länder. Das Märchenschloss Neuschwanstein steht in den bayerischen Alpen.

GHA.title: Near 0°, 0°
GHA.body: The equator and the prime meridian meet in the Gulf of Guinea, just south of Ghana, so Ghana is one of the closest countries to that point. It is also one of the world’s top cocoa growers.
GHA.local: The equator and the prime meridian meet in the Gulf of Guinea, just south of Ghana, so Ghana is one of the closest countries to that point. Ghana is also one of the world’s top cocoa growers.

GRC.title: First Olympics
GRC.body: The ancient Olympic Games began in Olympia, Greece, nearly 2,800 years ago.
GRC.local: Οι αρχαίοι Ολυμπιακοί Αγώνες ξεκίνησαν στην Ολυμπία της Ελλάδας πριν από σχεδόν 2.800 χρόνια.

GRL.title: Largest island
GRL.body: Greenland is the largest island in the world that is not a continent. An ice sheet covers most of it.
GRL.local: Kalaallit Nunaat nunarsuarmi qeqertaq annerpaavoq, nunat angisuut ilanngunneqaratik. Sermersuaq annertunerpaamik qallersimava.

GTM.title: Tikal
GTM.body: Tikal, in Guatemala, is a great Maya city whose temples rise above the rainforest.
GTM.local: Tikal, en Guatemala, es una gran ciudad maya cuyos templos se alzan sobre la selva.

GIN.title: Source of the Niger
GIN.body: The Niger River begins in the Fouta Djallon highlands of Guinea.
GIN.local: Le fleuve Niger prend sa source dans les hauts plateaux du Fouta-Djalon, en Guinée.

GNB.title: Turtle islands
GNB.body: Guinea-Bissau’s Bijagós Islands are a biosphere reserve where sea turtles come ashore to nest.
GNB.local: As ilhas Bijagós, na Guiné-Bissau, são uma reserva da biosfera onde as tartarugas marinhas vêm desovar.

GUY.title: Kaieteur
GUY.body: Kaieteur Falls, in Guyana, is one of the most powerful single-drop waterfalls on Earth.
GUY.local: Kaieteur Falls, in Guyana, is one of the most powerful single-drop waterfalls on Earth.

HTI.title: First Black republic
HTI.body: In 1804 Haiti became the world’s first Black republic, after a successful revolt of enslaved people.
HTI.local: En 1804, Haïti est devenue la première république noire du monde, après une révolte victorieuse d’esclaves.

HND.title: Copán
HND.body: Copán, in Honduras, is a Maya city famous for tall carved stone monuments called stelae.
HND.local: Copán, en Honduras, es una ciudad maya famosa por altas estelas de piedra tallada.

HUN.title: Paprika and the Danube
HUN.body: Hungary’s parliament stands on the Danube in Budapest. The country is famous for paprika, a ground red pepper.
HUN.local: A magyar parlament a Dunánál áll Budapesten. Az ország a paprikáról híres.

ISL.title: Fire and ice
ISL.body: Iceland sits where two tectonic plates pull apart. It runs almost entirely on geothermal heat and hydropower.
ISL.local: Ísland situr þar sem tvær jarðskorpuplötur færast í sundur. Það keyrir nær allt á jarðvarma og vatnsafli.

IND.title: Largest democracy
IND.body: India is the world’s largest democracy by population. It is also the country that grows the most bananas.
IND.local: भारत जनसंख्या के हिसाब से दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा लोकतंत्र है। केले भी सबसे ज़्यादा यहीं उगाए जाते हैं।

IDN.title: Largest archipelago
IDN.body: Indonesia is the world’s largest archipelago, with more than 17,000 islands, and the biggest country the equator crosses.
IDN.local: Indonesia adalah negara kepulauan terbesar di dunia, dengan lebih dari 17.000 pulau, dan negara terbesar yang dilintasi khatulistiwa.

IRN.title: Persepolis
IRN.body: Persepolis, in Iran, was the ceremonial capital of the ancient Persian empire. Its stone stairways are covered in carvings.
IRN.local: تخت جمشید در ایران پایتخت آیینی شاهنشاهی هخامنشی بود. پلکان‌های سنگی‌اش پر از نقش است.

IRQ.title: Where writing began
IRQ.body: Iraq covers much of ancient Mesopotamia, between the Tigris and the Euphrates, where people first wrote with cuneiform.
IRQ.local: يغطي العراق كثيرا من بلاد الرافدين القديمة، بين دجلة والفرات، حيث بدأ الناس الكتابة بالمسمارية.

IRL.title: Book of Kells
IRL.body: Ireland is called the Emerald Isle because of its rain and green grass. The Book of Kells, a medieval gospel book, is kept in Dublin.
IRL.local: Ireland is called the Emerald Isle because of its rain and green grass. The Book of Kells, a medieval gospel book, is kept in Dublin.

ISR.title: The lowest shore
ISR.body: The Dead Sea, on Israel’s border, is the lowest point on land. The water is so salty that people float easily.
ISR.local: ים המלח, על גבול ישראל, הוא הנקודה הנמוכה ביותר ביבשה. המים כל כך מלוחים שאנשים צפים בקלות.

ITA.title: The boot
ITA.body: Italy is shaped like a boot. It has more UNESCO World Heritage sites than almost any other country.
ITA.local: L'Italia ha la forma di uno stivale. Ha più siti patrimonio dell'umanità UNESCO di quasi ogni altro paese.

CIV.title: Cocoa champion
CIV.body: Côte d’Ivoire grows more cocoa beans than any other country. Much of the world’s chocolate starts there.
CIV.local: La Côte d’Ivoire produit plus de fèves de cacao que tout autre pays. Une grande partie du chocolat du monde commence là.

JAM.title: Birthplace of reggae
JAM.body: Reggae music was born in Jamaica. The island’s sprinters, including Usain Bolt, have held many world records.
JAM.local: Reggae music was born in Jamaica. The island’s sprinters, including Usain Bolt, have held many world records.

JPN.title: A country of islands
JPN.body: Japan is made of more than 14,000 islands. Mount Fuji is its tallest peak.
JPN.local: 日本は1万4千を超える島からなります。富士山が一番高い山です。

JOR.title: A city in the rock
JOR.body: Petra, in Jordan, is a city carved into rose-colored cliffs more than two thousand years ago.
JOR.local: البتراء في الأردن مدينة نُحتت في صخور وردية قبل أكثر من ألفي سنة.

KAZ.title: Largest landlocked country
KAZ.body: Kazakhstan is the world’s largest landlocked country. Many crewed spaceflights have launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome there.
KAZ.local: Қазақстан — құрлықтағы ең үлкен теңізге шықпайтын ел. Көптеген ғарыш ұшулары Байқоңырдан басталады.

KEN.title: Stand on the equator
KEN.body: The equator crosses Kenya, so a person can stand in both hemispheres at once. The Great Rift Valley runs through the country.
KEN.local: Ikweta inapita Kenya, hivyo mtu anaweza kusimama katika hemispheres zote mbili. Bonde la Ufa Mkuu linapita nchini.

KWT.title: Pearl coast
KWT.body: Before oil, Kuwait’s coast was famous for pearl diving. The Kuwait Towers are the symbol of its modern capital.
KWT.local: قبل النفط، اشتهر ساحل الكويت بالغوص على اللؤلؤ. وأبراج الكويت رمز العاصمة الحديثة.

KGZ.title: A lake that does not freeze
KGZ.body: Issyk-Kul, in Kyrgyzstan, is one of the world’s largest mountain lakes. It is so deep and slightly salty that it does not freeze.
KGZ.local: Кыргызстандагы Ысык-Көл дүйнөдөгү эң чоң тоо көлдөрүнүн бири. Терең жана бир аз туздуу болгондуктан тоңбойт.

LAO.title: Landlocked Mekong
LAO.body: Laos is the only landlocked country in Southeast Asia. Temples in Luang Prabang line the Mekong River.
LAO.local: ລາວເປັນປະເທດດຽວໃນອາຊີຕາເວັນອອກສຽງໃຕ້ທີ່ບໍ່ມີທາງອອກທະເລ. ວັດໃນຫຼວງພະບາງຢູ່ລຽບແມ່ນ້ຳຂອງ.

LVA.title: Art nouveau capital
LVA.body: Riga, in Latvia, has one of the finest collections of art nouveau buildings in Europe.
LVA.local: Rīgā, Latvijā, ir viena no izcilākajām jūgendstila ēku kolekcijām Eiropā.

LBN.title: The cedar
LBN.body: The cedar of Lebanon is on the country’s flag. Byblos is one of the oldest cities where people have lived without a break.
LBN.local: أرز لبنان على علم البلاد. وجبيل من أقدم المدن التي سكنها الناس بلا انقطاع.

LSO.title: High kingdom
LSO.body: Lesotho is one of the few countries that lie entirely above 1,000 meters, and it is completely surrounded by South Africa.
LSO.local: Lesotho is one of the few countries that lie entirely above 1,000 meters, and it is completely surrounded by South Africa.

LBR.title: Founded by freed people
LBR.body: Liberia was founded by freed people from the United States. Its capital, Monrovia, is named for President James Monroe.
LBR.local: Liberia was founded by freed people from the United States. Its capital, Monrovia, is named for President James Monroe.

LBY.title: Sahara shores
LBY.body: Libya has a long Mediterranean coast and deep Sahara. The ancient Greek city of Cyrene stood in its east.
LBY.local: لليبيا ساحل طويل على المتوسط وصحراء شاسعة. وقامت مدينة قورينا الإغريقية في شرقها.

LTU.title: Hill of Crosses
LTU.body: The Hill of Crosses in Lithuania is covered with hundreds of thousands of crosses left by pilgrims. In the Middle Ages Lithuania ruled a huge grand duchy.
LTU.local: Lietuvos Kryžių kalnas apstatytas šimtais tūkstančių kryžių. Viduramžiais Lietuva valdė didelę kunigaikštystę.

LUX.title: Small and founding
LUX.body: Luxembourg is one of the world’s smallest countries and a founder of what became the European Union.
LUX.local: Le Luxembourg est l’un des plus petits pays du monde et un fondateur de ce qui est devenu l’Union européenne.

MDG.title: Island of lemurs
MDG.body: Madagascar split from Africa tens of millions of years ago. Most of its animals, including lemurs, live nowhere else.
MDG.local: Madagascar s’est séparée de l’Afrique il y a des dizaines de millions d’années. La plupart de ses animaux, dont les lémuriens, n’existent nulle part ailleurs.

MWI.title: Lake of fishes
MWI.body: Malawi is known as the warm heart of Africa. Lake Malawi holds more kinds of fish than almost any other lake.
MWI.local: Malawi is known as the warm heart of Africa. Lake Malawi holds more kinds of fish than almost any other lake.

MYS.title: Towers and rainforest
MYS.body: The Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur were once the world’s tallest buildings. Malaysia also shares the rainforest island of Borneo.
MYS.local: Menara Petronas di Kuala Lumpur pernah menjadi bangunan tertinggi di dunia. Malaysia juga berkongsi pulau hutan Borneo.

MLI.title: Timbuktu
MLI.body: Timbuktu, in Mali, was a great center of learning and of trade across the Sahara.
MLI.local: Tomboctou, au Mali, fut un grand centre de savoir et de commerce à travers le Sahara.

MRT.title: Desert ports
MRT.body: Mauritania’s old caravan towns, the ksour, rise out of the Sahara. The country links North Africa and West Africa.
MRT.local: تنهض مدن القوافل القديمة في موريتانيا، القصور، من الصحراء. والبلد يصل شمال أفريقيا بغربها.

MEX.title: Home of maize
MEX.body: Maize was first farmed in what is now Mexico thousands of years ago. Mexico City is one of the largest cities on Earth.
MEX.local: El maíz se cultivó por primera vez en lo que hoy es México hace miles de años. La Ciudad de México es una de las más grandes del mundo.

MDA.title: Underground wine
MDA.body: Moldova is famous for underground wine cellars. Mileștii Mici holds one of the largest wine collections on Earth.
MDA.local: Moldova este faimoasă pentru cramele subterane. Mileștii Mici păstrează una dintre cele mai mari colecții de vin din lume.

MNG.title: Open country
MNG.body: Mongolia is the most sparsely populated country on Earth. Many families still move with their herds across the steppe.
MNG.local: Монгол бол дэлхийн хамгийн сийрэг хүн амтай улс. Олон айл малтайгаа тал нутгаар нүүдэллэсээр байна.

MNE.title: Black mountains
MNE.body: Montenegro’s name means “black mountain.” The Bay of Kotor is a deep, winding inlet of the Adriatic.
MNE.local: Ime Crna Gora znači „crna planina“. Boka Kotorska je dubok, vijugav zaliv Jadrana.

MAR.title: The Atlas
MAR.body: The Atlas Mountains cross Morocco, which faces both the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea.
MAR.local: تعبر جبال الأطلس المغرب، المطل على المحيط الأطلسي والبحر المتوسط معا.

MOZ.title: A long ocean coast
MOZ.body: Mozambique has one of Africa’s longest Indian Ocean coasts. Stone Island of Mozambique was a historic trading port.
MOZ.local: Moçambique tem uma das costas mais longas de África no oceano Índico. A Ilha de Moçambique foi um porto histórico.

MMR.title: Plain of temples
MMR.body: The plain of Bagan in Myanmar is covered with thousands of ancient Buddhist temples.
MMR.local: မြန်မာနိုင်ငံ ပုဂံလွင်ပြင်တွင် ရှေးဟောင်းဘုရားပုထိုး ထောင်ပေါင်းများစွာ ရှိသည်။

NAM.title: Red dunes
NAM.body: Namibia’s Sossusvlei has some of the tallest red sand dunes on Earth, and the Skeleton Coast is a foggy desert shore.
NAM.local: Namibia’s Sossusvlei has some of the tallest red sand dunes on Earth, and the Skeleton Coast is a foggy desert shore.

NPL.title: Roof of the world
NPL.body: Eight of the world’s fourteen highest peaks rise in Nepal, including Mount Everest on the border with China.
NPL.local: विश्वका चौध उच्च शिखरमध्ये आठ नेपालमा छन्, चीनको सिमानामा सगरमाथा पनि।

NLD.title: Below the sea
NLD.body: About a quarter of the Netherlands lies below sea level. Dikes and pumps hold the water back, and the country is famous for bicycles and tulips.
NLD.local: Ongeveer een kwart van Nederland ligt onder zeeniveau. Dijken en gemalen houden het water tegen, en het land is beroemd om fietsen en tulpen.

NZL.title: First to the vote
NZL.body: In 1893 New Zealand became the first country where women won the right to vote in national elections.
NZL.local: In 1893 New Zealand became the first country where women won the right to vote in national elections.

NCL.title: A giant lagoon
NCL.body: New Caledonia’s barrier reef encloses one of the largest coral lagoons on Earth.
NCL.local: Le récif de Nouvelle-Calédonie entoure l’un des plus grands lagons coralliens de la Terre.

NIC.title: Lake of sharks
NIC.body: Lake Nicaragua is the largest lake in Central America. It is one of the rare lakes with sharks that live in fresh water.
NIC.local: El lago de Nicaragua es el más grande de América Central. Es de los pocos lagos con tiburones de agua dulce.

NER.title: Gate of the desert
NER.body: Niger takes its name from the Niger River. The mud-brick city of Agadez has long been a gateway to the Sahara.
NER.local: Le Niger tient son nom du fleuve Niger. La ville en banco d’Agadez est depuis longtemps une porte du Sahara.

NGA.title: Most people in Africa
NGA.body: Nigeria has more people than any other country in Africa. Its film industry, Nollywood, is one of the busiest in the world.
NGA.local: Nigeria has more people than any other country in Africa. Its film industry, Nollywood, is one of the busiest in the world.

PRK.title: Sacred volcano
PRK.body: Mount Paektu, a volcano on North Korea’s northern border, has a crater lake and is the highest peak on the peninsula.
PRK.local: 북한 북쪽 국경의 화산 백두산에는 화구호가 있고, 한반도에서 가장 높은 산이다.

MKD.title: Ancient lake
MKD.body: Lake Ohrid, shared by North Macedonia, is one of the oldest and deepest lakes in Europe.
MKD.local: Охридското Езеро, кое го дели Северна Македонија, е едно од најстарите и најдлабоките езера во Европа.

NOR.title: Longest road tunnel
NOR.body: Norway’s coast is cut by deep fjords. The Lærdal Tunnel is the longest road tunnel in the world.
NOR.local: Norges kyst er skåret opp av dype fjorder. Lærdalstunnelen er verdens lengste veitunnel.

OMN.title: Forts of incense
OMN.body: Oman’s forts guarded old incense routes. The country has a long coast where desert mountains meet the Arabian Sea.
OMN.local: حمت قلاع عمان طرق البخور القديمة. وللسلطنة ساحل طويل حيث تلتقي جبال الصحراء ببحر العرب.

PAK.title: Second-highest peak
PAK.body: K2, in Pakistan’s Karakoram, is the second-highest mountain on Earth.
PAK.local: پاکستان کے سلسلہ کوہ قراقرم میں کے ٹو دنیا کی دوسری بلند ترین چوٹی ہے۔

PSE.title: Olive hills
PSE.body: Bethlehem, in Palestine, is traditionally known as the birthplace of Jesus. Olive groves cover many of the hills.
PSE.local: بيت لحم في فلسطين تُعرف تقليديا بأنها مولد يسوع. وبساتين الزيتون تغطي كثيرا من التلال.

PAN.title: The shortcut between oceans
PAN.body: The Panama Canal joins the Atlantic and the Pacific, so ships cross a continent instead of sailing around South America.
PAN.local: El canal de Panamá une el Atlántico y el Pacífico, así que los barcos cruzan un continente en vez de rodear América del Sur.

PNG.title: Most languages
PNG.body: Papua New Guinea has more languages than any other country, over 800, in a land of mountains and reefs.
PNG.local: Papua New Guinea has more languages than any other country, over 800, in a land of mountains and reefs.

PRY.title: Two everyday languages
PRY.body: In Paraguay most people speak both Spanish and Guaraní, a pairing that is rare for a whole country.
PRY.local: En Paraguay la mayoría habla español y guaraní, una pareja de lenguas poco común en todo un país.

PER.title: City in the clouds
PER.body: Machu Picchu, built by the Inca, sits high in Peru’s Andes. Lake Titicaca, shared with Bolivia, is the highest large navigable lake.
PER.local: Machu Picchu, construido por los incas, está alto en los Andes del Perú. El lago Titicaca, compartido con Bolivia, es el lago navegable grande más alto.

PHL.title: Thousands of islands
PHL.body: The Philippines is made of more than 7,000 islands. The Puerto Princesa underground river runs through a cave to the sea.
PHL.local: Mahigit 7,000 pulo ang Pilipinas. Ang ilog sa ilalim ng lupa ng Puerto Princesa ay dumadaan sa kuweba papunta sa dagat.

POL.title: Bison and Copernicus
POL.body: Poland’s Białowieża Forest shelters European bison. Nicolaus Copernicus, who showed that Earth orbits the Sun, was born in Toruń.
POL.local: W Puszczy Białowieskiej żyją żubry. Mikołaj Kopernik, który pokazał, że Ziemia krąży wokół Słońca, urodził się w Toruniu.

PRT.title: Edge of Europe
PRT.body: Portugal is the westernmost country of mainland Europe. Its sailors opened sea routes around Africa and to Brazil.
PRT.local: Portugal é o país mais ocidental da Europa continental. Os seus marinheiros abriram rotas marítimas à volta de África e até ao Brasil.

PRI.title: Glowing bays
PRI.body: Puerto Rico has bays that glow blue at night because of tiny living organisms in the water.
PRI.local: Puerto Rico tiene bahías que brillan de azul por la noche por organismos diminutos en el agua.

QAT.title: A pearling peninsula
QAT.body: Qatar sits on a peninsula in the Persian Gulf. Its capital, Doha, grew from a town of pearl divers.
QAT.local: تقع قطر على شبه جزيرة في الخليج. ونشأت عاصمتها الدوحة من بلدة غواصي اللؤلؤ.

ROU.title: Painted monasteries
ROU.body: Romania’s Carpathian Mountains curve through the country. The monasteries of Bucovina are famous for paintings on their outside walls.
ROU.local: Munții Carpați străbat România. Mănăstirile din Bucovina sunt faimoase pentru picturile de pe zidurile exterioare.

RUS.title: Largest country
RUS.body: Russia is the largest country by area. It stretches across eleven time zones, more than any other country.
RUS.local: Россия — самая большая страна по площади. Она протянулась через одиннадцать часовых поясов, больше, чем любая другая.

RWA.title: Land of a thousand hills
RWA.body: Rwanda is called the land of a thousand hills. Its mountain forests are one of the last homes of the mountain gorilla.
RWA.local: Rwanda inaitwa nchi ya vilima elfu. Misitu yake ya milimani ni makazi ya mwisho ya sokwe wa milimani.

SAU.title: Holy cities and empty quarter
SAU.body: Saudi Arabia holds Mecca and Medina, the holiest cities in Islam, and the Rub’ al Khali, one of the largest sand deserts.
SAU.local: في السعودية مكة والمدينة، أقدس مدينتين في الإسلام، والربع الخالي، من أكبر الصحارى الرملية.

SEN.title: Teranga
SEN.body: Dakar sits near the westernmost point of mainland Africa. Senegal is known for teranga, a word for warm hospitality.
SEN.local: Dakar est près de la pointe la plus occidentale de l’Afrique continentale. Le Sénégal est connu pour la teranga, l’hospitalité.

SRB.title: Where two rivers meet
SRB.body: Belgrade, Serbia’s capital, stands where the Sava River meets the Danube.
SRB.local: Beograd, glavni grad Srbije, stoji tamo gde Sava uliva u Dunav.

SLE.title: Lion mountains
SLE.body: Sierra Leone’s name means “lion mountains,” from the shape of the hills behind its coast. The country protects chimpanzees.
SLE.local: Sierra Leone’s name means “lion mountains,” from the shape of the hills behind its coast. The country protects chimpanzees.

SGP.title: City and country
SGP.body: Singapore is both a city and a country at the tip of the Malay Peninsula, and it is one of the busiest ports on Earth.
SGP.local: 新加坡既是城市也是国家，位于马来半岛南端，是地球上最繁忙的港口之一。

SVK.title: High Tatras
SVK.body: Slovakia’s High Tatras are a sharp alpine range, and the country has huge caves, some of them filled with ice.
SVK.local: Vysoké Tatry na Slovensku sú ostré alpské štíty a krajina má obrovské jaskyne, niektoré plné ľadu.

SVN.title: Lake with an island
SVN.body: Lake Bled in Slovenia has a church on a small island. More than half the country is forest.
SVN.local: Blejsko jezero v Sloveniji ima cerkev na otočku. Več kot polovica države je gozd.

SLB.title: Reefs and languages
SLB.body: The Solomon Islands are a chain of volcanic islands and coral reefs in the Pacific, with dozens of distinct languages.
SLB.local: The Solomon Islands are a chain of volcanic islands and coral reefs in the Pacific, with dozens of distinct languages.

SOM.title: Longest mainland coast
SOM.body: Somalia has the longest coastline of any country on mainland Africa, along the Indian Ocean and the Gulf of Aden.
SOM.local: Soomaaliya waxay leedahay xeebta ugu dheer waddamada barriga Afrika, ee Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed.

ZAF.title: Three capitals
ZAF.body: South Africa has three capitals: Pretoria, Cape Town, and Bloemfontein. It is one of the only countries set up this way.
ZAF.local: South Africa has three capitals: Pretoria, Cape Town, and Bloemfontein. It is one of the only countries set up this way.

KOR.title: An alphabet made to be learned
KOR.body: Hangul, the Korean alphabet, was designed in the 1400s to be easy to learn. South Korea also built some of the fastest public internet.
KOR.local: 한글은 1400년대에 배우기 쉽도록 만들어진 글자입니다. 한국은 아주 빠른 공공 인터넷도 깔았습니다.

SSD.title: Youngest country
SSD.body: South Sudan became independent in 2011, making it the world’s youngest country. The Sudd is one of Africa’s largest wetlands.
SSD.local: South Sudan became independent in 2011, making it the world’s youngest country. The Sudd is one of Africa’s largest wetlands.

ESP.title: Two seas
ESP.body: Spain has a long coast on both the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea.
ESP.local: España tiene una costa larga en el océano Atlántico y en el mar Mediterráneo.

LKA.title: Ceylon tea
LKA.body: Sri Lanka, shaped a little like a teardrop, is famous for Ceylon tea. Sigiriya is an ancient fortress built on a giant rock.
LKA.local: ශ්‍රී ලංකාව තේ සඳහා ප්‍රකටය. සීගිරිය යනු දැවැන්ත පර්වතයක් මත ඉදිකළ පුරාණ බලකොටුවකි.

SDN.title: More pyramids
SDN.body: Sudan has more pyramids than Egypt. They were built by the Kingdom of Kush at places such as Meroë.
SDN.local: في السودان أهرامات أكثر من مصر. بناها ملكوت كوش في أماكن مثل مروي.

SUR.title: Rainforest country
SUR.body: Suriname is the smallest country in South America and is mostly rainforest. Paramaribo’s old center is full of wooden houses.
SUR.local: Suriname is het kleinste land van Zuid-Amerika en bestaat grotendeels uit regenwoud. Het oude centrum van Paramaribo staat vol houten huizen.

SWE.title: The Nobel Prizes
SWE.body: Sweden awards the Nobel Prizes each year for science, literature, and peace. The prizes were created by Alfred Nobel.
SWE.local: Sverige delar varje år ut Nobelpris i vetenskap, litteratur och fred. Prisen skapades av Alfred Nobel.

CHE.title: Four languages
CHE.body: Switzerland has four official languages: German, French, Italian, and Romansh. It stayed neutral through both world wars.
CHE.local: Die Schweiz hat vier Amtssprachen: Deutsch, Französisch, Italienisch und Rätoromanisch. Sie blieb in beiden Weltkriegen neutral.

SYR.title: Ancient capital
SYR.body: Damascus, Syria’s capital, is often called the oldest capital still lived in. Palmyra was a great trading city in the desert.
SYR.local: دمشق، عاصمة سوريا، تُسمى غالبا أقدم عاصمة ما زالت مأهولة. وكانت تدمر مدينة تجارة عظيمة في الصحراء.

TWN.title: Bubble tea
TWN.body: Bubble tea was invented in Taiwan in the 1980s. Jade Mountain, on the island, is one of the highest peaks in East Asia.
TWN.local: 珍珠奶茶在1980年代发明于台湾。岛上的玉山是东亚最高的山峰之一。

TJK.title: Mountains first
TJK.body: Tajikistan is the most mountainous country in Central Asia. The Pamirs are called the roof of the world.
TJK.local: Тоҷикистон кӯҳсортарин кишвари Осиёи Марказист. Помирро боми ҷаҳон мегӯянд.

TZA.title: Kilimanjaro
TZA.body: Kilimanjaro, in Tanzania, is the tallest mountain in Africa. Its summit is a volcano standing by itself.
TZA.local: Kilimanjaro, nchini Tanzania, ni mlima mrefu kuliko yote barani Afrika. Kilele chake ni volkeno inayosimama peke yake.

THA.title: Never colonized
THA.body: Thailand is the only country in Southeast Asia that was never colonized by a European power.
THA.local: ประเทศไทยเป็นประเทศเดียวในเอเชียตะวันออกเฉียงใต้ที่ไม่เคยเป็นอาณานิคมของชาวยุโรป

TLS.title: A new country
TLS.body: Timor-Leste became independent in 2002. It covers the eastern half of the island of Timor.
TLS.local: Timor-Leste tornou-se independente em 2002. Ocupa a metade oriental da ilha de Timor.

TGO.title: A narrow coast
TGO.body: Togo is a narrow country with a short coast on the Gulf of Guinea. Its capital, Lomé, is a busy market city.
TGO.local: Le Togo est un pays étroit avec une courte côte sur le golfe de Guinée. Sa capitale, Lomé, est une grande ville de marchés.

TTO.title: The steelpan
TTO.body: Trinidad and Tobago invented the steelpan, the only acoustic instrument invented in the 20th century.
TTO.local: Trinidad and Tobago invented the steelpan, the only acoustic instrument invented in the 20th century.

TUN.title: Carthage
TUN.body: Carthage, in Tunisia, was a great city that rivaled ancient Rome. The country has a long Mediterranean coast.
TUN.local: كانت قرطاج في تونس مدينة عظيمة نافست روما. وللبلاد ساحل طويل على المتوسط.

TUR.title: A city on two continents
TUR.body: Istanbul is a major city that sits on two continents. The Bosphorus splits it between Europe and Asia.
TUR.local: İstanbul iki kıtada birden duran büyük bir şehirdir. İstanbul Boğazı onu Avrupa ile Asya arasında böler.

TKM.title: Door to hell
TKM.body: The Darvaza gas crater in Turkmenistan’s Karakum Desert has burned for decades and is nicknamed the Door to Hell.
TKM.local: Türkmenistanyň Garagum çölündäki Derweze gazy onlarça ýyl bäri ýanýar we oňa dowzahyň gapyşy diýilýär.

UGA.title: Gorillas and a great lake
UGA.body: Uganda sits on the equator and holds part of Lake Victoria, Africa’s largest lake. Mountain gorillas live in Bwindi forest.
UGA.local: Uganda iko kwenye ikweta na ina sehemu ya ziwa Victoria, ziwa kubwa kuliko yote barani Afrika. Sokwe wa milimani wanaishi msitu wa Bwindi.

UKR.title: Grain and sunflowers
UKR.body: Ukraine is one of the world’s great grain growers and is known for sunflower fields and decorated Easter eggs called pysanky.
UKR.local: Україна — один із найбільших виробників зерна у світі. Вона відома соняшниками та розписаними писанками.

ARE.title: Tallest building
ARE.body: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai, in the United Arab Emirates, is the tallest building ever built.
ARE.local: برج خليفة في دبي، في الإمارات، هو أطول مبنى بُني على الإطلاق.

GBR.title: Four nations, one meridian
GBR.body: The United Kingdom is four countries under one flag: England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Greenwich, in London, marks 0 degrees longitude.
GBR.local: The United Kingdom is four countries under one flag: England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Greenwich, in London, marks 0 degrees longitude.

USA.title: First national park
USA.body: Yellowstone, created in 1872, was the world’s first national park. The United States also has the largest economy.
USA.local: Yellowstone, created in 1872, was the world’s first national park. The United States also has the largest economy.

URY.title: First World Cup
URY.body: Uruguay hosted and won the first men’s football World Cup, in 1930.
URY.local: Uruguay organizó y ganó la primera Copa Mundial masculina de fútbol, en 1930.

UZB.title: Silk Road cities
UZB.body: Samarkand and Bukhara, in Uzbekistan, were great cities of the Silk Road, covered in blue tile.
UZB.local: Oʻzbekistondagi Samarqand va Buxoro Buyuk ipak yoʻlining shaharlari boʻlib, koʻk koshinlar bilan bezatilgan.

VUT.title: Land divers
VUT.body: On Pentecost Island in Vanuatu, land divers leap from wooden towers with vines on their ankles, a tradition that inspired bungee jumping.
VUT.local: On Pentecost Island in Vanuatu, land divers leap from wooden towers with vines on their ankles, a tradition that inspired bungee jumping.

VEN.title: Tallest waterfall
VEN.body: Angel Falls, in Venezuela, is the tallest waterfall on Earth. The water drops nearly a kilometer.
VEN.local: El salto Ángel, en Venezuela, es la catarata más alta de la Tierra. El agua cae casi un kilómetro.

VNM.title: Bay of islands
VNM.body: Vietnam is a long coastal country. Ha Long Bay holds thousands of limestone islands rising from the sea.
VNM.local: Việt Nam là một đất nước ven biển dài. Vịnh Hạ Long có hàng nghìn đảo đá vôi nhô lên từ biển.

ESH.title: Dune coast
ESH.body: Western Sahara is a desert territory on the Atlantic, known for a long dune coast and Sahrawi nomadic culture.
ESH.local: الصحراء الغربية أرض صحراوية على الأطلسي، معروفة بساحل كثبان طويل وثقافة صحراوية رحّالة.

YEM.title: Dragon’s blood trees
YEM.body: Socotra, an island of Yemen, has plants that grow nowhere else, including the dragon’s blood tree. Sana’a’s old city is famous for tower houses.
YEM.local: في سقطرى، جزيرة يمنية، نباتات لا تنمو في مكان آخر، منها شجرة دم الأخوين. ومدينة صنعاء القديمة مشهورة ببيوتها البرجية.

ZMB.title: The smoke that thunders
ZMB.body: Zambia shares Victoria Falls with Zimbabwe. The falls are one of the largest curtains of falling water, called Mosi-oa-Tunya, “the smoke that thunders.”
ZMB.local: Zambia shares Victoria Falls with Zimbabwe. The falls are one of the largest curtains of falling water, called Mosi-oa-Tunya, “the smoke that thunders.”

ZWE.title: Great Zimbabwe
ZWE.body: Great Zimbabwe is a medieval stone city that gave the country its name. Zimbabwe also shares Victoria Falls.
ZWE.local: Great Zimbabwe is a medieval stone city that gave the country its name. Zimbabwe also shares Victoria Falls.
